caseName: Town of Walkerton v. New York, Chicago & St. Louis Railroad
caseNameFull: Town of Walkerton v. New York, Chicago & St. Louis Railroad Co.
attorneys: Mr. Henry M. Dowling for petitioner. Mr. Russell P. Harker for respondent.
judges: Are, Black, Granted, Should, That, Writ

opinions.text:
Petition for writ of certiorari to the Supreme Court of Indiana denied.

Mr. Justice Black and Mr. Justice Douglas are of the opinion that the petition for writ of certiorari should be granted.
